name: limit_fill_direction_outside_the_face
why: THE DIRECTION MUST RUN ALONG THE FACE. An edge of the thickness (along Y, perpendicular to the top face) is straight, and the guard of «linear_pattern» would accept it; but the fill lays out the copies INSIDE the boundary face, and a direction that leaves it has no way to go in there. The operation reads the direction of the edge (LineParams) and the normal of the face, refuses when the direction leaves the plane (here by 90 degrees) and says to indicate one of the straight edges of the face. The twin is the same step with the edge along X of the top face, which runs along the face.

expect.tolerance_why: the diameter is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
72000 minus pi*4^2*12: the calculation has pi inside

message_includes: is not in the plane of the boundary face
